title: Martial Law Order No 1317 Repeal Act 1989

sections.shortTitle: Martial Law Order No 1317 Repeal Act 1989
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VI OF 1989
ACT VI OF 1989
MARTIAL LAW ORDER
NO. 1317 (REPEAL) ACT, 1989
An Act to repeal
the Martial Law Order No. 1371, dated February 9, 1984 issued by MLA Zone A
(Punjab) (Ban on Student Unions)
[Gazette of Punjab
Extraordinary, 9th April, 1989]
No. Legis-2(11)/89/21, dated
9-4-1989.--The Martial Law Order No.1371 (Repeal) Bill, 1989, having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 29th day of March 1989
and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 6th day of April 1989, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Martial Law Order No.1371
(Repeal) Act, 1989.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
